instruction: Find a hotel in Rome for 3 adults, sort the results by lowest price, and stay on the results page.

spec.script: (()=>{const L=['Our top picks','Lowest price first','Star rating and price','Top reviewed'];const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x=>L.includes(x.textContent.trim())).find(x=>x.className.includes('bg-booking-blue'));return b?b.textContent.trim():null;})()
